artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Titlepage]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image displays two vases with floral arrangements on either side of a central design, featuring the upper part of a human figure. The color palette consists of shades of grey and black, typical of engravings. On the left is a vase labeled "HOMO" with a floral arrangement and a squirrel, while the right vase labeled "BVLLA" has another floral display with an owl. Above, a decorative network of birds, a bat, and serpentine elements encircle the central figure, with inscriptions in Latin framing the composition.

artworks.title: Plate 1. Carmichael's Cut, Granite Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railroad track running through a rocky landscape. The track starts from the bottom right corner and extends diagonally towards the center-left. The scene lacks a visible horizon, as rocky walls flank the track on both sides. A man is standing near the base of the rock face on the right side. The rocks are depicted in shades of gray and brown. Snow patches are visible along the track, with a pale, overcast beige sky above.

artworks.title: Plate 2. Granite Canon, from the Water Tank
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway track stretching into the distance. The track is positioned towards the left edge of the image, running diagonally towards the horizon, which is placed around the upper third of the image. A small building sits on the horizon line, near the center of the image. The terrain on either side of the railway appears rocky and barren, with a few small pools of water visible to the left. The color palette is predominantly sepia tones, giving the image a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: Plate 3. Granite Rock, near Beaufort Station
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with large, rounded rock formations and sparse pine trees. The viewpoint is slightly from below, looking up at the rocks. The horizon is not clearly defined, as the landscape is filled with rock formations, trees, and sky. The photograph has a monochromatic style with sepia tones. Rocks and dry grass are near us, while larger rock formations and trees are further back. In the background, more rock formations and trees extend to the horizon.

artworks.title: Plate 4. Malloy's Cut
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railroad track stretching into the distance, passing through a narrow cut between rocky banks. Steep banks rise on either side. The horizon is low in the image, emphasizing depth and vastness in the sky. A man stands on the right side of the tracks, facing down the line. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving an older feel. The photo features detailed textures and appears to be captured in monochrome film. The scene is well-lit, showing the rugged textures of the earth and rocks beside the tracks.

artworks.title: Plate 5. Hall's Cut
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway track extending into the distance with a person standing on the tracks. The view is enclosed by steep, rocky walls on both sides. Snow is piled up alongside the tracks with footprints visible in the snow. The color palette includes earth tones of the rocks and bright whites of the snow, creating a striking contrast.

artworks.title: Plate 6. Skull Rock
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky formation from a low angle. The rocks are unevenly stacked, with a person standing on the tallest point. The background is dominated by the rocks, with a hint of a horizon. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving the image an aged look. In the foreground, there is grass with some smaller rocks, and in the distance, there are shrubs and a slightly overcast sky. Multiple people are seen around the rocks.

artworks.title: Plate 7. Dale Creek Bridge, General View
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The perspective is from a low angle, showing a large wooden trestle bridge spanning horizontally across the upper section of the image. The horizon is positioned just above the center, with the dominant structure of the bridge stretching from left to right. The foreground features rugged terrain with rocks and sparse vegetation. In the distance, there is an open space beneath the bridge with scattered materials that appear to be lumber. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones, creating an aged and historical feel. The details are crisp, showing the texture of the rocks and the fine structure of the bridge.

artworks.title: Plate 8. Dale Creek Bridge, from Above
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a valley with a group of people and structures. There is a wooden trestle bridge dominating the horizon. On the left, rocky terrain with boulders and sparse trees is visible. Near us, individuals are near a campsite with a lit lamp and wagons, one with a horse. The ground is cluttered with materials and vegetation leading to a less detailed background. The image has a monochromatic color palette, appearing like a historical photograph in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Plate 9. Eastern Approach to Dale Creek Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows railway tracks curving through rocky terrain. The perspective is elevated, looking down at the tracks as they lead away. The horizon is high in the image with a small section of the sky visible. Trees and low vegetation are seen on the horizon. Earthy tones dominate the composition. The rocks are rough and large, likely from construction. A person is sitting on a large pipe crossing over the tracks. The scene conveys ruggedness and human presence in nature.

artworks.title: Plate 10. Devil's Gate, Dale Creek Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rocky terrain, two men standing on a boulder, and a distant figure on another rock. The horizon line is not visible, and the scene is dominated by rocky formations with sparse vegetation. The image is in monochrome, highlighting textures and shadows. Scattered trees add vertical elements, and the lighting emphasizes the landscape's contours.

artworks.title: Plate 11. General Grant and Party at Fort Sanders
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people standing in front of a wooden building resembling a log cabin with a wide, shingled roof and a chimney. The individuals are shown on a wooden porch with a simple fence, including men, women, and children. The men wear top hats and suits, while the women wear long dresses, with one woman standing out in a light-colored dress. Two children in hats and dresses are in the center, and a dog is sitting on the ground. The setting includes a bare-earth yard with sparse trees, an American flag to the left, and longhorn skulls on the cabin exterior. The background shows lattice work under the deck, enhancing the rustic frontier aesthetic.

artworks.title: Plate 12. Dial Rock, Red Buttes
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a rugged landscape with eroded rock formations dominating the scene. The viewpoint is at ground level, looking up at the towering rocks. The horizon extends into the distance with a hazy sky. The color palette is monochromatic brown. Sparse shrubbery covers the terrain, contrasting with the rock formations. A small figure sits on the rocks near the center, providing scale.

artworks.title: Plate 13. Snow and Timber Line, Laramie Mountains
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated point, overlooking a dense forest of trees at varying heights. A prominent tree with bare branches is seen in the foreground, stretching out to the right side. The horizon is relatively high, featuring distant outlines of mountains blending into the sky. The color palette is monochromatic sepia tones, and the image has a textured quality, giving it a timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Plate 14. Valley of the Great Laramie, from the Mountains
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated point. Tall trees frame the scene on both sides, with rolling hills meeting the sky in the distance. A winding river runs through a valley below with dense vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving a nostalgic feel. The image appears to be a photograph, capturing a serene and expansive natural environment.

artworks.title: Plate 15. Laramie Hotel, Laramie City
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway station scene with railroad tracks running parallel, stretching into the distance towards the horizon. Multiple parallel railway tracks filled with gravel are on the right, while two large rectangular buildings are on the left. The station building closest to us is long and two-storied with small windows and a modest entrance awning. Small groups of people are around, with some standing or walking closer to the buildings. Stones and debris are scattered near the tracks closest to the viewer. The image has a sepia-toned palette with dominant shades of brown, beige, and gray against a light sky.

artworks.title: Plate 16. The Wind Mill at Laramie
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a steam locomotive on railway tracks, with a windmill to the left and an industrial building in the distance. The horizon line is low, set by the tracks and buildings, emphasizing the sky. The windmill has a tail and lattice-like blades, casting shadows on a water tank nearby. An industrial building extends behind the train, with a few figures standing by the tracks. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones. Textures of the ground and rocks, as well as the shapes and shadows of the structures, are clearly defined in this historic scene.

artworks.title: Plate 17. Laramie Machine Shops, from the Southwest
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image is taken from a ground-level point of view, looking across a railroad yard. In the middle area, there are several flatbed railcars parallel to a row of stone buildings with numerous chimneys. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the buildings and railcars dominate the scene. There is a prominent brick chimney rising from the largest building. Close to us, there is a wooden structure on saw horses. Beyond this, standing on the ground, are two figures. The sky above is clear, contributing to an overall monochromatic palette dominated by sepia tones. A telegraph pole stands upright in the middle area.

artworks.title: Plate 18. Valley of the Little Laramie River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view from an elevated position. The horizon is located in the upper third of the composition, blending into the bright sky. In the foreground, there are grassy slopes, bushy foliage, and a meandering river partially hidden by trees. Further away, the land transitions into an open plain with sparse vegetation. The image uses subtle contrasts of light and dark to define the land features.

artworks.title: Plate 19. Among the Timber at Head of Little Laramie River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows individuals near tent structures in a wooded area, with a view of tall trees and a steep hillside. The angle is from below looking upwards, showing the dense trees and mountain slope. The horizon is not visible due to the trees and slope dominating the view. The photograph is in black and white, emphasizing contrasts. Details of foliage and leaves are visible, reflecting early photographic techniques. The focus is on the stark delineation of trees and landscape in shades of grey.

artworks.title: Plate 20. Source of the Laramie River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a scenic landscape with a river winding through hills in the distance. A group of people is gathered near a tree on the left side. The tree's branches create a pattern against the sky. The river runs diagonally across the image. The color palette is subdued with soft browns and beiges.

artworks.title: Plate 21. High Bluff, Black Buttes
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with sandstone formations. The view is from a low angle, looking up at the rock formations on the right. There is a horizon line with distant hills and flat expanses. Three human figures are scaling the rocks, with one assisting another climber. Close by, there are more rocks and sparse vegetation. In the distance, the land is flat with a focus on vast, desolate terrain. A horse with a rider stands on a rock formation on the right. The color palette is sepia, giving the image a vintage look. The rocks have a weathered texture, contrasting with the smooth sky which is clear.

artworks.title: Plate 22. Burning Rock Cut
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow, rocky passageway with steep, layered rock walls on either side. The perspective is from inside the passageway, looking straight down the path. The horizon is partially visible in the distance, where the passageway opens up to a broader landscape with faint hills or mountains. The rocks are textured and uneven, with layers visible, suggesting sedimentary formation. Close to us, on both sides of the path, the rock walls rise steeply. The image has a monochromatic sepia tone. There are figures within the passageway, standing to the right, giving scale to the rock walls. The sky above is clear, with no visible clouds.

artworks.title: Plate 23. On the Mountains of Green River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a high vantage point looking across a rocky terrain. A steep cliff rises on the right side with people standing at the top. The horizon is placed low in the image, providing a panoramic view. In the distance, another rugged formation rises from the land. The color palette is monochromatic with earth tones. The scene conveys a sense of vastness and natural beauty.
